title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
**Paid Media Specialist / Performance Marketing Specialist** **About the Role**
We are looking for a Paid Media / Performance Marketing Specialist who can independently plan, execute, optimize, and report on multi\-channel paid media campaigns for domestic and international clients.  

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, DV360, and preferably Teads Ad Manager, with a strong understanding of campaign strategy, audience targeting, tracking, analytics, optimization, and client communication. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Paid Media Strategy \& Planning*** Develop comprehensive paid media strategies based on client objectives, target audiences, budgets, and KPIs.
* Create and present media plans covering budget allocation, channel mix, audience targeting, campaign objectives, bidding strategies, and creative requirements.
* Recommend the right combination of Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360, Teads, and other relevant paid media channels.
* Identify opportunities to integrate paid media with SEO, content, email, social media, and other digital/ATL channels.
Conduct competitor, audience, keyword, and market research to identify growth opportunities.  
* 

  

**2\. Paid Media Campaign Execution \& Management*** Set up, manage, monitor, and optimize campaigns


**o Google Ads – Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Demand Gen, Shopping****o Meta Ads – Facebook \& Instagram****o LinkedIn Ads****o TikTok Ads****o DV360****o Teads Ad Manager**  

* Conduct keyword research, audience research, placement analysis, negative keyword management, and targeting optimization.
* Manage campaign budgets, bids, pacing, frequency, reach, and performance against KPIs.
* Implement A/B and multivariate testing across creatives, audiences, landing pages, bidding strategies, ad copies, and campaign structures.
* Continuously optimize campaigns to improve ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversions, and overall campaign efficiency.
* Ensure campaigns follow appropriate taxonomy, naming conventions, tracking, brand safety, and platform best practices.
* Identify and resolve campaign delivery, tracking, attribution, and performance issues.
* Assist with account restructuring and creation of new campaign elements wherever required

 **3\. Tracking, Analytics \& Measurement*** Work with relevant teams to ensure accurate implementation of Google Tag Manager, GA4, conversion tracking, pixels, UTMs, Floodlight, and other tracking solutions.
* Monitor campaign attribution and data quality.
* Analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, DV360, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other reporting platforms.
* Identify gaps in tracking and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure campaign data is reliable and aligned with client reporting requirements.  
* 

  

**4\. Reporting \& Insights*** Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc performance reports for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Analyze campaign data and translate it into clear, actionable insights.
* Highlight key performance trends, challenges, opportunities, and recommendations.
* Present campaign performance and optimization recommendations to internal teams and clients.
Maintain accurate campaign trackers, budgets, pacing reports, and performance dashboards.  
* 

  

**5\. Campaign Optimization \& Growth*** Proactively identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, scalability, and efficiency.
* Develop and implement new testing methodologies across audiences, creatives, bidding, placements, keywords, and campaign structures.
* Identify opportunities for budget reallocation based on channel and campaign performance.
* Stay updated with changes in Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360, Teads, GA4, and the broader paid media ecosystem.
* Explore new advertising products, beta features, automation solutions, and emerging platforms.

 **6\. Client Management \& Communication*** Act as a secondary point of contact for assigned clients and maintain strong professional relationships.
* Participate in regular client calls to discuss campaign performance, upcoming campaigns, strategy, and optimization opportunities.
* Understand client briefs and translate business objectives into effective paid media strategies.
* Communicate campaign results, insights, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
Coordinate with internal teams including SEO, Content, Creative, Development, Analytics, and Business Development to deliver integrated digital marketing solutions.  
* 

  

**7\. Media Partner Management*** Build and maintain effective relationships with media and technology partners.
* Coordinate with platform representatives and partners for campaign support, troubleshooting, optimization opportunities, and industry updates.
* Explore relevant alpha/beta programs, new platform features, and testing opportunities.
Share campaign briefs with partners and incorporate relevant recommendations into media strategies.  
* 

  

**Required Skills \& Experience*** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Paid Media / Performance Marketing.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads
* Experience with one or more of DV360, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, and Teads Ad Manager.
* Strong understanding of:


 o Google Search Ads
 o Performance Max
 o YouTube Ads
 o Display Advertising
 o Remarketing/Retargeting
 o Audience Targeting
 o Lead Generation
 o Conversion Campaigns
 o Shopping Ads
* Good understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and attribution.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Experience with campaign reporting and performance dashboards.
* Good understanding of KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, Reach, Frequency and Conversion Rate.
* Strong communication and client\-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications*** Google Ads certification.
* Meta Blueprint certification.
* Experience handling international clients, particularly US, UK, Canada, or Australia.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency environment.
* Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.
* Experience with Looker Studio or other visualization/reporting tools.
* Knowledge of marketing attribution, incrementality, and advanced measurement methodologies.

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Business stakeholders, driving the successful development and deployment of AI\-powered agents and intelligent automation platforms.

  

The ideal candidate combines strong product management skills with a technical understanding of AI/ML technologies, agentic architecture, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise software delivery. You will own the product roadmap, PI planning, delivery execution, dependency management, and cross\-functional alignment to ensure successful realization of strategic AI initiatives.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

	+ Drive prioritization of features, capabilities, and technical investments across multiple workstreams
	+ Partners with leadership teams to identify opportunities to leverage Agentic AI for productivity, automation, and business transformation
	+ Establish product success metrics, KPIs, and adoption measures
* End\-to\-End Agentic AI Delivery
	+ Lead end\-to\-end implementation of Agentic AI solutions, from ideation and planning through deployment and operationalization
	+ Drive execution across AI, engineering, platform, infrastructure, security, and business teams
	+ Manage delivery milestones, implementation schedules, and release plans
	+ Ensure alignment between business requirements, technical architecture, and execution priorities
	+ Oversee solution readiness, launch planning, and adoption strategies
* Engineering Collaboration
	+ Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, and Platform teams to execute product roadmaps
	+ Translate complex technical concepts into actionable product requirements and user stories
	+ Support design and implementation of AI agents, orchestration workflows, integrations, and automation capabilities
	+ Participate in architecture reviews, technical planning, and solution design discussions
	+ Drive trade\-off decisions balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, timelines, and risks
* Program \& Release Management
	+ Lead Program Increment (PI) Planning and cross\-team execution activities
	+ Coordinate with Project and Program Managers to build detailed project plans, track milestones, and manage dependencies
	+ Establish governance mechanisms to monitor delivery progress and stakeholder commitments
	+ Identify, escalate, and resolve cross\-functional blockers and risks
	+ Drive executive\-level reporting and communication on roadmap progress and delivery status
* Stakeholder Management
	+ Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Security, Compliance, Business, and Executive Stakeholders
	+ Facilitate alignment across multiple teams and organizations
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for AI product delivery initiatives
	+ Present roadmap updates, implementation status, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* AI Innovation \& Governance
	+ Stay current with emerging Agentic AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends
	+ Evaluate and recommend AI platforms, LLMs, orchestration frameworks, and tooling
	+ Ensure adherence to responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance standards
	+ Support AI adoption and change management initiatives across the organization
  

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline
* 8\+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, or related experience
* Experience leading enterprise\-scale technology implementations
* Experience managing cross\-functional delivery across Product, Engineering, and Business teams
* Experience owning product roadmaps, release planning, and execution governance
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/ML products, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions

 **Preferred Qualification:**

* MBA or master's degree

title: Product Portfolio Architect
description:
**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

Our organization is embarking on a massive digital transformation journey: the E\&C ALign Program. By 2027, we aim to deliver a globally integrated digital system for E\&C. A core component of this transformation includes migrating our engineering design suite from SmartPlant to AVEVA, alongside
  

the deployment of a new ERP system (Sap/4Hana) and a Project \& Portfolio Management (PPM) tool.We are seeking a Product Portfolio Architect to act as the Coordinator during the critical Design, Build \& Deployment phases of the E\&C ALign Program. This role ensures that the technical specifications provided to our System Integrators (SIs) are cohesive across our four domains (Project
  

Management, Engineering, Sales\&Technologies, and Manufacturing/OT) and that the resulting architecture is robust, scalable, and fully maintainable when handed over to the DDS InnoTech for "Run Mode." The Product Portfolio Architect will also be acting for the harmonization of the business applications within InnoTech perimeter, and the initiation of the related projects.
1\. Manage Cross\-Domain Digital Solutions roadmaps


Bridging the E\&C ALign program and the InnoTech Core Business Domains.


Ensure with the Integration and Architecture team the overall architecture compliance and coherency.


Contribute to review and harmonize specifications sent to the System Integrator, ensuring that integrations between the new AVEVA suite, the ERP, and existing tools create a seamless "Digital Thread”.


2\. Ensure the Maintainability \& Operational Readiness of the portfolio


Ensure that the integrated solutions being built in the Align Program are manageable, supportable, and cost\-effective for the Core Business Domains team post\-Go\-Live.Execute the handover strategy from the project phase to the operational phase, including support models (processes and SLAs definitions), licensing considerations, and internal IT upskilling.


Identify and mitigate technical debts or over\-customizations proposed by System Integrators or E\&C Business representatives that could complicate the “run” phase and/or future software upgrades.


3\. Secure DDS delivery to the Align Program


Manage Leadership \& Stakeholder Management


Work in a matrixed environment under the guidance of the E\&C ALign IT Project Manager and the E\&C ALign Design Authority to ensure project milestones are met on time and within scope. Collaborate with Business Process Owners (BPOs) and the Design Authority to ensure the technical


architecture actually supports the targeted "One E\&C Mindset" global processes, and that the business requirements are not exceeding the actual needs. Apply Product Management principles to the integrated EPC toolset, treating the overarching IT ecosystem as a holistic product delivering end\-to\-end value. Liaise with the Architecture Director, the Head of the Core Business Domains, the EPC Program Director, the transversal services Director and DDS VP.


4\. Rationalize the Digital Solutions portfolio @ InnoTech


Serve as the forward\-looking integration lead to prepare for driving the strategic harmonization of IT applications when relevant.


Assess opportunities for consolidation, cost savings, and standardization with Domain Managers and Product Managers.


**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

Senior Leadership in IT: 7\+ years of experience in IT, with a strong background in heading digital products or acting as a Product Owner for internal enterprise suites. Large\-Scale Transformations: Proven track record of playing a lead technical or integration role in large, multi\-year IT transformation programs (ERP deployments, PLM implementations, etc.).

title: AI Enterprise Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an **AI Enterprise Product Manager** to drive the next phase of evolution of our existing enterprise AI platform. The core platform and several major capabilities are already developed. The mandate for this role is to **enhance the product, improve user adoption, strengthen the subscription experience, identify product gaps and continuously evolve the platform based on customer usage and market requirements**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously evolve the **product roadmap** for an existing AI enterprise platform.
* Deeply understand the current platform, its capabilities, user journeys and architecture, and identify opportunities for **enhancement, simplification and better adoption**.
* Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, sales inputs and market developments into clearly prioritized product improvements.
* Improve the overall **user journey from signup and onboarding to activation, regular usage, subscription and expansion**.
* Enhance the platform's **subscription model**, including plans, feature entitlements, trials, upgrades, usage controls and monetization opportunities.
* Identify friction in the product and improve **self\-service adoption and time\-to\-value**.
* Work closely with engineering and AI teams to enhance existing capabilities and introduce new features without unnecessarily increasing product complexity.
* Evaluate whether customer requirements should become **reusable platform capabilities** rather than customer\-specific implementations.
* Define detailed **PRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria and release priorities**.
* Own prioritization across **product enhancements, customer requirements, technical improvements and strategic platform capabilities**.
* Define and track key product metrics including **activation, feature adoption, trial conversion, paid conversion, retention, usage and expansion**.
* Use product analytics and customer behavior to identify underused capabilities, adoption bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular customer and user discovery to validate product decisions and identify emerging requirements.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to ensure alignment between **product capabilities, packaging, positioning and customer expectations**.
* Continuously track developments across **Enterprise AI, AI agents, agentic platforms and enterprise SaaS** and translate relevant developments into product decisions.

**Required Skills** 

* Strong experience in **B2B SaaS or enterprise product management**.
* Strong understanding of **subscription\-based SaaS products**, including onboarding, trials, plans, entitlements, upgrades and usage\-based/product\-tier monetization.
* Good understanding of **enterprise software, workflows and business processes**.
* Practical understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows**.
* Strong ability to evaluate an existing product and identify **UX, capability, adoption and monetization gaps**.
* Ability to distinguish between a **customer\-specific requirement and a scalable platform capability**.
* Strong experience with **product discovery, roadmap prioritization, PRDs, user stories and release management**.
* Understanding of SaaS/product metrics including **activation, conversion, retention, churn, engagement and expansion**.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams and understand **APIs, integrations, data flows and platform concepts**.
* Strong analytical, customer\-discovery and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate with significant ownership in a **fast\-moving product environment**.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or a related discipline**.
* **2–4 years of overall product management experience**, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Demonstrable experience managing and **evolving an existing software product or platform**, rather than only launching greenfield products.
* Experience working with a **subscription\-based SaaS product** with multiple plans or tiers.
* Experience improving **product adoption, onboarding, engagement and conversion**.
* Prior exposure to **AI/Generative AI, enterprise automation, workflow platforms or developer platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Experience taking a product from **early\-stage development to customer adoption and commercial scale** would be a significant advantage.
* Prior experience working with an **enterprise SaaS startup or product company** is preferred.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
